conditions.source: Frozen source identity; clean pushed main before publication
conditions.package: Exact source/tree/ZIP parity and bounded permitted files
conditions.metadata: Synchronized version, readme, generated contracts and translations
conditions.standards: Syntax, WPCS, PHP compatibility, complexity and regression tests
conditions.requests: Method, capability and nonce before administrative payloads
conditions.validation: Bounded exact input schemas; no copied or forwarded superglobals
conditions.escaping: Final-context escaping and reviewed non-HTML protocol emitters
conditions.wordpress_apis: Prepared SQL, WP_Filesystem, Transients API and safe core includes
conditions.assets_licenses: Readable public sources, build instructions and compatible licenses
conditions.standalone: All Core functionality works without licensing or an external updater
conditions.services_consent: Documented services, appropriate consent and optional public credits
conditions.plugin_check: Current pinned checker, standard and experimental runtime checks, no findings
conditions.runtime: Exact ZIP passes supported runtimes, browser, lifecycle and multisite checks
conditions.agent_review: Specific current evidence closes all policy and reviewer obligations
conditions.website_prepared: Exact source commit/channel imported; guides reviewed; website tests, build and verification passed
conditions.website_live: Published tag deployed to cybermaps.dev; production contracts, downloads and changelog verified
